service.name: Input_ProcessPrimaryPattern
behavior: Samples the two controller phases through the Z80 bus handoff and reduces each phase to the 0x30-bit pattern fields.
When both sampled fields are released, consumes a pending match by advancing INPUT_PATTERN_CURSOR by two bytes and resets the cursor on the 0xFF terminator.
When a field is pressed, compares both bytes with the active primary pattern record and sets INPUT_PATTERN_MATCH_LATCH only on an exact match; mismatch selects the primary table again.
On the terminal pattern, optionally queues audio commands 0x02 and 0x5B around SceneResource_WaitForCompletion calls, reselects the primary table, and writes SCENE_SCRIPT_COUNTDOWN to 0xFF.

relationship.menu_counterpart: 0x001B0BBE Input_ProcessMenuPattern uses the alternate selector and enters Menu_ShowWishPrompt instead of this service's countdown/audio handshake.
relationship.known_state: The static body establishes the controller-pattern and scene/audio side effects; it does not by itself establish the user-facing meaning of the primary pattern.

conclusion: The anonymous frame-side routine is a primary controller-pattern service. Its cursor/latch state and terminal scene/audio handshake are now distinct from the alternate menu wish-pattern path.
